card.title: IPhone 5

claims.statement: On iPhone 5, prying between the battery connector and the shield behind it can knock off tiny resistors, causing battery misreporting or the phone only working on the charger.

procedure: Inspect around the battery connector for missing resistors; replace from donor.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Don't pry between the battery connector and the shield.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
